Senses.Explanation: Buying dear and selling cheap figures a knowingly disadvantageous exchange, especially the costly giving away of Chan transmission. Baichi applies it to his opened shop, Xutang to transmitted incense and Zhaozhou’s case, and Jiufeng’s quoted reply supplies the terse market judgment; the Budai verse marks the figurative limit.
